scripts.features:
Um script avançado em Luau com um drone 3D totalmente funcional, otimizado para telemóvel e PC.
- Controles táteis (joysticks virtuais) para altura, rotação e movimento.
- Vários modos de voo: Manual, Descolagem, Regressar a Casa (RTH), Seguir e Aterragem.
- Câmara FPV com HUD, telemetria em tempo real (altitude, velocidade, distância, bateria) e zoom.
- Efeitos e extras: Luzes LED personalizáveis, Visão Térmica, Largar Bombas com explosão e Autodestruição.

-- // Delta Executor - Drone com Comando Estilo DJI RC (v3 com Térmico e Bombas)
-- Só toque (telemóvel): joystick esquerdo = altura/girar | joystick direito = mover

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Se executares o script outra vez, limpa a versão anterior
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.__DroneCleanup then pcall(env.__DroneCleanup) end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

if Workspace:FindFirstChild("RealisticDroneModel") then Workspace.RealisticDroneModel:Destroy() end
if player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DJIRCControlGui") then player.PlayerGui.DJIRCControlGui:Destroy() end

-- Configuração
local SPEED, VSPEED, YAW_SPEED = 40, 25, 2.2
local DEFAULT_FOV = 70

-- Estado
local conns = {}
local flying, mode = false, "manual" -- manual | takeoff | rth | follow | land
local battery = 100
local yaw = 0
local curVel = Vector3.zero
local curTiltF, curTiltS = 0, 0
local rotorSpeed, rotorAngle = 0, 0
local cameraAttached, recording, recTime = false, false, 0
local fov = DEFAULT_FOV
local stickL, stickR = Vector2.zero, Vector2.zero
local rotors = {}

-- Efeitos extra
local thermalOn = false
local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")

local function getHumanoid()
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Modelo do drone
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local droneModel = Instance.new("Model")
droneModel.Name = "RealisticDroneModel"
droneModel.Parent = Workspace

local dronePart = Instance.new("Part")
dronePart.Name = "DroneCore"
dronePart.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.6, 2.5)
dronePart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
dronePart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 65)
dronePart.CanCollide = false
dronePart.Parent = droneModel
droneModel.PrimaryPart = dronePart

-- Raycast para descobrir o chão
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {droneModel, character}

local function groundY(pos)
    local r = Workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), rayParams)
    return r and r.Position.Y or nil
end

-- Posição inicial: no chão, à frente do jogador
local look = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
local startPos = rootPart.Position + look * 4
local startGround = groundY(startPos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
dronePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos.X, (startGround or (rootPart.Position.Y - 2.5)) + 0.9, startPos.Z)
    * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)

local function weldTo(p0, p1)
    local w = Instance.new("Weld")
    w.Part0 = p0
    w.Part1 = p1
    w.C0 = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
    w.Parent = p0
    return w
end

local function addPart(size, offset, color, material, shape)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Size = size
    p.CFrame = dronePart.CFrame * offset
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    if shape then p.Shape = shape end
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Massless = true
    p.Parent = droneModel
    return p, weldTo(dronePart, p)
end

-- Câmara gimbal e sensores
addPart(Vector3.new(0.6, 0.5, 0.6), CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.2), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.Metal)
addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.3), CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.45), Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255), Enum.Material.Glass)

-- Luz do drone

    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
    Color3.fromRGB(180, 80, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}

local lightOn = true
local lightPart = addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.1, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 0.35, 1.3), lightColors[1], Enum.Material.Neon)
local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
light.Color = lightColors[1]
light.Range = 15

-- Braços, motores e hélices

    for _, sz in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
        local corner = Vector3.new(sx * 1.7, 0, sz * 1.7)
        addPart(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.15, corner.Magnitude), CFrame.lookAt(corner / 2, corner),
            Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 80))
        addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.6, 0.6),
            CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
            Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30), Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
        local blade, bw = addPart(Vector3.new(2.2, 0.05, 0.25),
            CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0),
            Color3.fromRGB(240, 130, 0), Enum.Material.Neon)
        table.insert(rotors, {weld = bw, base = bw.C0, dir = (sx * sz > 0) and 1 or -1})
    end
end

local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
bv.Parent = dronePart

local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)

local btnContainer = make("Frame", {

local function createRcBtn(name, text, off, on, order)

end

-- Joysticks táteis
local function makeStick(pos, caption, callback)
    local base = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = pos,
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Active = true,
    }, screenGui)
    roundify(base, 50)
    make("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -16),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = caption,
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    }, base)
    local knob = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, base)
    roundify(knob, 20)

    local active
    local function update(p)
        local center = base.AbsolutePosition + base.AbsoluteSize / 2
        local maxR = base.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 - 8
        local delta = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center
        if delta.Magnitude > maxR then delta = delta.Unit * maxR end
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X, 0.5, delta.Y)
        callback(Vector2.new(delta.X / maxR, -delta.Y / maxR))
    end
    local function reset()
        active = nil
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        callback(Vector2.zero)
    end

    base.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            active = input
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not active then return end
        if input == active
            or (active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == active then reset() end
    end))
end

makeStick(UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, -65), "ALTURA / GIRAR", function(v) stickL = v end)

-- Arrastar o comando pela barra superior
do
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos2
    topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos2 = rcFrame.Position
        end
    end)
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input == dragging
            or (dragging.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then
            local d = input.Position - dragStart
            rcFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos2.X.Scale, startPos2.X.Offset + d.X,
                startPos2.Y.Scale, startPos2.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragging then dragging = nil end
    end))
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function cleanup()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    table.clear(conns)
    pcall(function()
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        camera.FieldOfView = DEFAULT_FOV
        local hum = getHumanoid()
        if hum then camera.CameraSubject = hum end
    end)
    colorCorrection.Parent = nil
    if droneModel then droneModel:Destroy() end
    if screenGui then screenGui:Destroy() end
    env.__DroneCleanup = nil
end
env.__DroneCleanup = cleanup

local function refreshFlyBtn()
    btns.fly.Text = flying and "🛬 Pousar" or "🚀 Voar"
    setBtn(btns.fly, flying)
end

local function setMode(m)
    mode = m
    setBtn(btns.rth, m == "rth")
    setBtn(btns.follow, m == "follow")
end

local function homePos()
    return rootPart.Position + rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 5 + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
end

local function followPos()
    return rootPart.Position - rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 6 + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
end

local function faceDir(v, dt)
    if v.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
    local target = math.atan2(-v.X, -v.Z)
    local diff = (target - yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    yaw = yaw + diff * math.min(1, dt * 4)
end

local function takePhoto()
    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    toast("📸 Foto guardada")
end

-- Botões de Ação

    if flying then
        if mode ~= "land" then setMode("land") end
    else

            toast("🔋 Bateria demasiado baixa")
            return

        flying = true

        refreshFlyBtn()
    end
end)

btns.cam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    cameraAttached = not cameraAttached
    hudGui.Visible = cameraAttached
    setBtn(btns.cam, cameraAttached)
    btns.cam.Text = cameraAttached and "👤 Jogador" or "👁️ Câmara"
    if cameraAttached then
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    else
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        camera.FieldOfView = DEFAULT_FOV
        local hum = getHumanoid()
        if hum then camera.CameraSubject = hum end
    end
end)

btns.rth.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not flying then toast("O drone está no chão") return end
    setMode(mode == "rth" and "manual" or "rth")
end)

btns.follow.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

end)

-- Nova Função: Térmico

        colorCorrection.Parent = Lighting
        toast("🌡️ Visão térmica ativa")
    else
        colorCorrection.Parent = nil
        toast("🌡️ Visão normal")
    end
end)

-- Nova Função: Largar Bomba
btns.drop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not flying then
        toast("O drone precisa de estar a voar")
        return
    end
    local bomb = Instance.new("Part")
    bomb.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
    bomb.Position = dronePart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    bomb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    bomb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
    bomb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    bomb.Parent = Workspace
    
    local touchedConn
    touchedConn = bomb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        if hit ~= dronePart and hit.Parent ~= droneModel then
            touchedConn:Disconnect()
            local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
            exp.Position = bomb.Position
            exp.BlastRadius = 8
            exp.BlastPressure = 10000
            exp.Parent = Workspace
            bomb:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    toast("📦 Carga largada!")
end)

btns.pull.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local target = rootPart.Position + rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * 4
    local y
    if flying then
        y = target.Y + 4
    else
        local gy = groundY(target + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
        y = (gy or (target.Y - 2.5)) + 0.9
    end
    dronePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(target.X, y, target.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
    curVel = Vector3.zero
end)

btns.boom.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if dronePart and dronePart.Parent then

        explosion.Position = dronePart.Position

-- Put this in a LocalScript inside StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- IDs
local SKYBOX_ID = "rbxassetid://137556956110247"
local DECAL_ID = "rbxassetid://109568063153769"
local JUMPSCARE_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://6129291390"
local JUMPSCARE_IMAGE_ID = "rbxassetid://109568063153769"
local AFTER_JUMPSCARE_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://94919056430713"

-- =========================
-- SKYBOX
-- =========================

local oldSky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
if oldSky then
	oldSky:Destroy()
end

local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
sky.Name = "CustomSky"

sky.SkyboxBk = SKYBOX_ID
sky.SkyboxDn = SKYBOX_ID
sky.SkyboxFt = SKYBOX_ID
sky.SkyboxLf = SKYBOX_ID
sky.SkyboxRt = SKYBOX_ID
sky.SkyboxUp = SKYBOX_ID

sky.Parent = Lighting

-- =========================
-- HINT
-- =========================

local hint = Instance.new("Hint")
hint.Text = "hacked by Andrew_123910"
hint.Parent = workspace

-- =========================
-- DECAL SPAM
-- =========================

local function addDecal(part)
	local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
	decal.Texture = DECAL_ID
	decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	decal.Parent = part
end

for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		addDecal(obj)
	end
end

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		addDecal(obj)
	end
end)

-- =========================
-- JUMPSCARE GUI
-- =========================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "JumpscareGui"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = playerGui

local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
image.Name = "JumpscareImage"
image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
image.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE_ID
image.Visible = true
image.Parent = gui

-- =========================
-- JUMPSCARE SOUND
-- =========================

local jumpscareSound = Instance.new("Sound")
jumpscareSound.Name = "JumpscareSound"
jumpscareSound.SoundId = JUMPSCARE_SOUND_ID
jumpscareSound.Volume = 1
jumpscareSound.Parent = gui

-- =========================
-- AFTER JUMPSCARE SOUND
-- =========================

local afterJumpscareSound = Instance.new("Sound")
afterJumpscareSound.Name = "AfterJumpscareSound"
afterJumpscareSound.SoundId = AFTER_JUMPSCARE_SOUND_ID
afterJumpscareSound.Volume = 1
afterJumpscareSound.Looped = true
afterJumpscareSound.Parent = workspace

-- =========================
-- JUMPSCARE ENDS
-- =========================

jumpscareSound.Ended:Connect(function()

	-- Remove jumpscare image
	gui:Destroy()

	-- Play sound after jumpscare
	afterJumpscareSound:Play()
end)

-- Start jumpscare first
jumpscareSound:Play()
